Outstanding 0.5 Acre Site Moy, Lahinch, Co. Clare - Cluster Development Zoning 
An exceptional opportunity to acquire a superb elevated site extending to approximately 0.5 acre, with the option to acquire a further 1.3 acres, enjoying a wonderful countryside setting in one of West Clare's most sought-after locations.
Situated just 5km from the renowned seaside resort of Lahinch and approximately 12km from the hugely popular coastal resort of Spanish Point, this outstanding property offers the rare combination of a peaceful countryside setting with some of County Clare's most spectacular beaches, tourist attractions and amenities right on its doorstep.
The site enjoys an elevated position with a wonderful sense of space and countryside surroundings, while remaining within easy reach of the vibrant communities of Lahinch, Ennistymon and Miltown Malbay. The location is particularly appealing for those seeking to enjoy the lifestyle associated with the Wild Atlantic Way, with the Atlantic coastline, beaches, surfing, golf, walking and a superb selection of cafés, restaurants, pubs and local amenities all within easy reach.
Of particular significance is the Cluster Development zoning associated with the property, which makes this a particularly interesting proposition for purchasers seeking a site with development potential in this highly desirable part of West Clare. The zoning is an important feature and should be of considerable interest to those looking for an opportunity to create a home or explore an appropriate development proposal, subject to planning permission and compliance with all relevant planning requirements.
An Exceptional Coastal Location
The nearby resort of Lahinch is one of Ireland's best-known seaside destinations, famous for its magnificent golden-sand beach stretching for almost 2km around Liscannor Bay. Lahinch is internationally recognised as a surfing destination and is also home to renowned links golf courses, while the town itself offers an excellent range of shops, restaurants, pubs, cafés, leisure facilities and visitor accommodation.
The location also provides easy access to Spanish Point, with its expansive sandy beach overlooking Mal Bay. Spanish Point is a Wild Atlantic Way Discovery Point and an internationally recognised Blue Flag beach, popular for swimming, surfing, walking and enjoying the spectacular Atlantic setting.
The wider area is exceptionally well placed for exploring the very best of County Clare. Ennistymon, a historic market town with a strong local community, is located close to Lahinch, with a dedicated cycleway and footpath connection between the two settlements. Miltown Malbay is also nearby, providing further day-to-day amenities and access to the coastline.
For tourism and recreation, the location is difficult to surpass. The world-famous Cliffs of Moher, the spectacular Burren & Cliffs of Moher UNESCO Global Geopark, the traditional music village of Doolin, the Aran Islands, Fanore and the wider Wild Atlantic Way are all within easy driving distance. Doolin, in particular, is renowned for traditional Irish music and acts as a gateway to the Aran Islands.
The larger commercial centre of Ennis is also readily accessible, providing an extensive range of shopping, business, educational, medical, sporting and leisure facilities. Shannon Airport provides an important international transport connection for the region, making this an attractive location not only for permanent occupation but also for those seeking a West Clare base within convenient reach of international travel.
With the Atlantic coastline, beaches and some of Ireland's most visited tourist attractions nearby, together with the convenience of Ennis and Shannon, this is a location that offers an exceptional balance between countryside living, coastal lifestyle and connectivity.
A Rare Opportunity
Sites of this nature, size and location rarely come to the market. The opportunity to acquire approximately 0.5 acre, with the potential to acquire a further 1.3 acres, combined with the stated Cluster Development zoning, makes this an opportunity that warrants immediate inspection.
Whether viewed as an opportunity to secure a substantial site in an outstanding coastal location or as a property with future development potential, this is a particularly interesting offering at an attractive asking price of 75,000.
Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the setting, location and potential of this exceptional property.
